docs.title: surinort-ast
docs.text: surinort-ast parses Suricata, Snort 2, and Snort 3 rules into a typed AST that can be queried, transformed, serialized, and printed again.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
pip install surinort-ast
surinort parse rules.rules

The README contains the full Python API and CLI reference.

docs.title: Scope
docs.text: The parser and printers are intended for source-to-source tooling. Analysis reports are heuristic and should be checked with the target IDS engine before changing a production ruleset.
